name: Omprakash Shah
shortBio: Started CodingMonk to make placement training practical: daily DSA practice, regular coding contests, system design and mock interviews, taught by mentors who build software for a living. Shapes the curriculum and works with students through every batch.

name: Dinesh Shah
shortBio: Works with TPOs, principals and deans to plan training around each campus's placement calendar, from the first pilot batch to the final offer report. Leads our partnerships with colleges in Bengaluru.
